sources.finding: ADE puts Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Factory Droid and OpenCode in one app; brain on your machines; desktop (macOS 13+, Windows 10/11 x64), ade CLI, web client, iOS TestFlight; lanes; free; AGPL-3.0; SDK MIT; runtime embedding exception; install scripts; ADE Beta.

sources.title: Welcome page
sources.finding: ADE runs every AI coding agent in one native workspace on macOS, Windows, iOS and the terminal, synced in real time; free and open source.

sources.title: Install guide
sources.finding: One-command install on macOS, Linux and Windows; desktop on macOS and Windows; brain runs headless on Linux as a systemd user service.

sources.title: Connect a machine
sources.finding: ade connect puts a machine on the ADE account; headless Linux brain; QR sign-in from a phone.

sources.title: Windows guide
sources.finding: Windows 10/11 x64 only; per-user NSIS installer; a short list of macOS-only features is missing.

sources.title: Open a project
sources.finding: Point ADE at a Git repository (local folder or GitHub clone); local state in .ade/.

sources.title: First task
sources.finding: Create a lane, start an agent, watch tool calls and review the diff.

sources.title: Machines and clients
sources.finding: Brain per machine; clients: desktop, ade CLI, owner-only hosted web client, iOS app, SSH-attached desktop; killing a client does not kill the work; account optional for single-machine use.

sources.title: Subagents
sources.finding: Provider-native subagents and ADE child chats (subagent and peer types) started with ade new chat --parent; children can use another provider and model and report back with a wake.

sources.title: Agents and models
sources.finding: Provider is the agent runtime and model is separate.

sources.title: Lanes
sources.finding: A lane is one git worktree and branch per task for parallel work.

sources.title: Lane environment
sources.finding: Per-lane port range, .localhost hostname, OAuth callback routing and optional env init.

sources.title: Work sessions
sources.finding: Agent chat, terminal or CLI session; closeout cards; background and scheduled work (wake, cron, re-check on CI).

sources.title: CTO
sources.finding: Persistent project-level operator with durable memory that spawns and wakes chats, reads Linear and spans lanes.

sources.title: Chat capabilities
sources.finding: Universal tools, create a lane, open a PR, resolve PR issues, capture proof, report completion, attach Linear, scheduled work.

sources.title: Chat context
sources.finding: Lane context, attachments, transcript, compaction and summaries.

sources.title: Permissions
sources.finding: Lane scope, provider permission modes mapped to Plan/Edit/Full auto/Custom, shared-config trust for .ade/ade.yaml, secrets in local encrypted stores.

sources.title: AI providers
sources.finding: Subscriptions (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Factory) or API keys (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, xAI, Mistral, Groq, OpenRouter...); 160+ models through OpenCode; custom OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible providers; model calls go from the machine to the provider.

sources.title: .ade configuration
sources.finding: .ade/ directory, shared ade.yaml versus local.yaml and what stays out of Git.

sources.title: GitHub integration
sources.finding: Token in the machine credential store; open, review and merge PRs with CI, comments and auto-merge; optional.

sources.title: Linear integration
sources.finding: Browse and search Linear issues, attach them to lanes and chats, carry the link through branches, commits and PRs.

sources.title: Issues feature spec
sources.finding: Linear, GitHub and Jira issues open natively and are editable in place (status, title, description, comments); launcher starts lanes and agents from any of them.

sources.title: Pull requests tool
sources.finding: PR tab with diff, checks, comments and merge (squash, merge, rebase); stacked PRs; auto-merge; merge bypass.

sources.title: Conflicts tool
sources.finding: Predict, simulate and resolve merge conflicts between lanes before merge.

sources.title: Files and editor
sources.finding: Review workbench with Monaco, diffs, conflict resolution and a Git panel (stage, commit, push).

sources.title: History
sources.finding: Commit graph per lane and unified activity feed.

sources.title: Automations
sources.finding: Rules with cron, action-event or webhook triggers; agent-session or built-in actions; guardrails; the Automations tab shows a Soon badge in production builds.

sources.title: Remote machines
sources.finding: SSH remote machines (bridge bootstrapped on first connect) and ADE Relay; use another machine from a chat with ade shell start --machine; work copies.

sources.title: iOS companion
sources.finding: SwiftUI app paired over WebSocket mirroring lanes, chats and PRs; start chats, review and merge from the phone; TestFlight.

sources.title: iOS Simulator tool
sources.finding: macOS-only drawer that builds, launches, mirrors and controls a booted simulator.

sources.title: Built-in browser
sources.finding: Browser pane in Work to inspect elements and hand context to an agent.

sources.title: Terminals
sources.finding: Agent chats, provider CLIs and plain shells scoped to lanes.

sources.title: Computer use and proof
sources.finding: Screenshots, recordings, browser traces, console logs and verification notes linked to chat, lane, PR or Linear issue.

sources.title: Architecture
